summary: Built multi-signal classifier: (1) POST /context-classify in daemon.js — computes rag_score (gateTask top1 cosine), dag_score (lexical ≥2-token overlap with current notes+done tasks, cap 10=1.0), complexity (word-count heuristic + audit/migrate/refactor/entire/sweep +0.2 bump), gate_decision (inject/scaffold/abstain). 1.8s timeout with lexical fallback. Returns top_notes on inject, scaffold_keys (top-3 dag matches) on scaffold. (2) hooks/classify.sh updated: loop detection (keep running/until/watch/monitor/retry/each time/whenever/poll), model selection (haiku when complexity<0.4+abstain, opus when complexity>0.7 or inject, else sonnet; subagent one tier below), context injection (note summaries on inject, scaffold hint with task keys on scaffold). (3) scripts/test-classifier.sh: 5 assertions across 4 cases — all pass. (4) smoke.sh: 111/0. Phase 1 eval in context-gate-eval.md also updated (task 6b04b7a6/25).

subject: Build full multi-signal classifier: rag_score + dag_score + complexity → route + context_level + model
description: Design and implement the upgraded UserPromptSubmit classifier. Replaces heuristic-only classify.sh with a 4-signal decision engine. New daemon endpoint /context-classify (rag_score, dag_score, complexity, scaffold_keys). 3-tier context level (none/scaffold/full). 4th route option (loop). Model selection for main+subagent. Test suite including today's failure case (positioning prompt → dag_score high → scaffold tier). Also recalibrate context gate on clean Phase 1 held-out labels.

summary: Built and live: /context-classify endpoint (rag_score+dag_score+complexity+gate_decision), classify.sh updated with loop detection + model selection + 3-tier context injection (inject/scaffold/abstain), test-classifier.sh 5/5 pass, gate recalibrated on Phase 1 labels (7 clean NOes, 0 regret). Positioning failure case now returns dag_score=1.0→scaffold. Verified live: next user prompt showed [Model routing] and loop detection firing correctly.
